title: dithyrea maritima
intro: Dithyrea maritima, commonly known as Gray's dithyrea or Gray's break-me-sharply, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Dithyrea maritima include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which make it a potential remedy for various health issues. Bioactive constituents of Dithyrea maritima include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
